chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Ibn ʿAbbās said: "ʿUmrah has entered into hajj until the Day of Resurrection."

key_terms.ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: the authority being quoted in the report
key_terms.الْحَجِّ: the major pilgrimage, within which ʿumrah is said to have entered
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةُ: the lesser pilgrimage rite associated here with hajj
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection, indicating lasting validity until the end of worldly time

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by saying that ʿumrah has entered into hajj until the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This hadith states that ʿumrah has been incorporated into hajj until the Day of Resurrection. It indicates an enduring legal relationship between the two rites within the jurisprudence of hajj.
